card.description:

Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Staff Ground Vehicle Advance  uyoiypoiManufacturing Engineer to support the development and production of advanced ground mobility and vehicle systems. This role focuses on mechanical and integrated systems including chassis, suspension, braking, hydraulics, pneumatics, and mobility platforms. 

The ideal candidate has strong experience in automotive, heavy vehicle, or defense vehicle manufacturing environments and is comfortable supporting both prototype and production operations. 

What you'll do:

 - 

 - Lead manufacturing engineering activities for vehicle and mobility systems  

 - Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, tooling, work instructions, and production flows for: 

 - Chassis and structural assemblies  

 - Suspension and braking systems  

 - Wheels, axles, and driveline components  

 - Hydraulic and pneumatic systems  

 - Trailer and mobility platforms  

 - Support vehicle integration, testing, and production readiness activities  

 - Partner with design engineering to improve manufacturability, reliability, testability, and producibility 

 - Drive root cause investigations and corrective actions for manufacturing issues  

 - Develop work instructions, quality standards, and inspection methods  

 - Support supplier qualification, process validation, and production readiness reviews 

 - Lead DFM/DFA reviews and transition new products into manufacturing 

 - Define manufacturing standards, process controls, and acceptance criteria 

 - Support failure analysis and reliability improvement initiatives 

 - Collaborate with production, quality, supply chain, and test engineering teams 

 - Mentor junior manufacturing engineers 

Tools & skills:

 - 

 - MES & QMS systems

 - 3DEXPERIENCE / Teamcenter (PLM) systems

 - Supplier manufacturing processes

 - 5S/visual management

 - Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Required qualifications:

 - 

 - 7+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in automotive, mobility, heavy equipment, or defense vehicle systems 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related field 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Experience with:  

 - Vehicle integration and assembly  

 - Hydraulics and pneumatics  

 - Chassis and braking systems  

 - Mechanical production systems 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

 - Knowledge of manufacturing process development and production scaling  

 - Strong understanding of DFM/DFA principles  

 - Experience with root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies  

Preferred qualifications:

 - 

 - Automotive OEM, defense vehicle, or off-road vehicle experience  

 - Experience supporting prototype-to-production transitions  

 - Knowledge of welding, fabrication, and structural assembly processes  

 - Familiarity with lean manufacturing and production optimization 

 - Experience with ERP/MES systems and manufacturing data analysis 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines 

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001 

 - Proficiency in CAD software

card.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Shield AI is seeking a senior Solutions Architect – Manufacturing to serve as the functional and technical authority for Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across Manufacturing, MRP/Supply Chain Planning, and the shop-floor-to-ERP technology stack. This role owns the design, configuration, and continuous improvement of Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and MRP capabilities, with deep, hands-on strength in MES, QMS, and PLM — ensuring plan, build, and quality processes operate as one coherent, well-architected system.

This is a hands-on, business-facing role. The Solutions Architect is expected to be the trusted advisor and go-to resource for Manufacturing and Quality business partners on any process change involving Oracle Fusion Manufacturing/Planning or the MES, QMS, and PLM bolt-on applications — translating business need into a scalable, well-architected solution, and then configuring and implementing that solution directly for medium-complexity projects. For large, complex initiatives, this person leads solution design and partners with Shield AI’s implementation partner to deliver, while remaining the accountable architect and voice of the business throughout.

Beyond core ERP, this role holds full ownership of Shield AI’s manufacturing-adjacent bolt-on application landscape — including MES, QMS, and PLM (Teamcenter) — and is responsible for how those systems integrate with Oracle Fusion ERP to form a coherent plan-to-build-to-quality operating model. This role partners closely with the other Solutions Architects for Supply Chain and Finance on shared MRP/planning signals, supplier quality matters tied to Procure-to-Pay and end-to-end integration with Finance/Accounting.



What you'll do: 




SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE & BUSINESS PARTNERSHIP

 - Designs and delivers technical solutions, creates detailed solution designs, specific integration points, and selects appropriate tools and frameworks. Collaboration with developers and engineers to implement solutions, conducts technical reviews and resolves design challenges.

 - Documents architectures, provides technical guidance during development, and ensures solutions adhere to performance, security, and interoperability requirements. Prototypes new approaches and evaluates emerging technologies for project suitability.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for business partners across Manufacturing, Production Planning, Quality, and Engineering on process design and system capability questions.

 - Act as the lead advocate for Manufacturing and Quality stakeholders in all ERP, MES, QMS, and PLM-related discussions, ensuring their operational needs, constraints, and priorities are represented in solution design.

 - Become the go-to resource for any proposed Manufacturing or Quality process change, evaluating impact, feasibility, and fit within the Oracle Fusion ERP data model and integration landscape before implementation.

 - Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that balance standard Oracle Fusion functionality against configuration, extension, or integration needs.

 - Maintain a working command of adjacent end-to-end flows (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay) to ensure Manufacturing, MRP, MES, and QMS designs do not create downstream conflicts or gaps.


HANDS-ON CONFIGURATION & DELIVERY

 - Directly configure Oracle Fusion Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning/MRP, Work Definitions, Quality Inspections, and related modules for medium-sized projects, enhancements, and break/fix work.

 - Build, test, and deploy configuration changes, including setup of Fusion functional areas, security, workflows, approval rules, and data structures related to manufacturing and planning processes.

 - Author functional design documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and process/procedure documentation to support changes made in the environment.

 - For large or highly complex initiatives, define solution architecture and requirements, then partner closely with the implementation partner to execute — remaining accountable for solution quality, business fit, and knowledge transfer.

 - Participate in and help lead workshops, fit-gap sessions, and design reviews with Manufacturing and Quality stakeholders and implementation partner teams.


MRP, MES & QMS OWNERSHIP

 - Own MRP and Supply Chain Planning configuration — planning parameters, supply/demand netting, exception messages, and planner workbench — ensuring plans translate cleanly into executable work orders.

 - Own the functional roadmap, configuration governance, and business alignment for:

–    MES (Manufacturing Execution System) — work order execution, shop-floor data collection, routing/operation tracking

–    QMS (Quality Management System) — inspections, non-conformance, corrective/preventive action (CAPA), supplier quality

–    PLM – Teamcenter — engineering BOM, item master, and change management integration with Oracle Fusion

 - Ensure MES, QMS, and PLM remain architecturally aligned with Oracle Fusion Manufacturing and MRP, avoiding duplicate data ownership, conflicting BOM/routing data, or process gaps across systems.

 - Define and maintain the target integration model between MES, QMS, PLM, and Oracle Fusion ERP, including engineering-to-manufacturing BOM transfer and quality event-to-ERP disposition flows.

 - Partner with the Solutions Architect – Supply Chain on supplier-quality data flowing from Procure-to-Pay into QMS-driven supplier corrective action processes.


INTEGRATIONS

 - Design and help implement integrations between Oracle Fusion ERP and MES, QMS, and PLM (Teamcenter), including BOM/routing sync, work order status, and quality disposition data.

 - Define integration requirements, data mappings, and error-handling/reconciliation approaches in partnership with technical/integration teams.

 - Evaluate integration patterns (API, middleware, file-based) and recommend approaches appropriate to data volume, latency, and criticality, particularly for shop-floor/real-time data.

 - Support testing, cutover, and hypercare activities for integration-related changes.


GOVERNANCE & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Maintain configuration standards, documentation, and change control discipline for the Manufacturing, MRP, MES, QMS, and PLM functional areas.

 - Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved data quality across planning, production, and quality cycles.

 - Stay current on Oracle Fusion quarterly releases relevant to Manufacturing and Planning, and assess/recommend adoption of new features.

 - Mentor junior functional/technical resources and contribute to a growing internal ERP center of excellence.

Required Qualifications:

 - 12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise ERP systems, with significant depth in MRP/Supply Chain Planning, MES, and QMS functions.

 - Hands-on experience configuring Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP (Manufacturing and Planning pillars); comfortable working directly in the application, not solely at a requirements level.

 - Experience across multiple full-lifecycle ERP implementations (Oracle Fusion required; prior experience with Oracle EBS, SAP, or other major ERP platforms is a plus).

 - Direct, hands-on experience with at least one MES platform and one QMS platform, including their integration into an ERP environment.

 - Working knowledge of Order-to-Cash and Procure-to-Pay processes and how they interact with Manufacturing, MRP, and quality operations.

 - Demonstrated experience acting as a functional/solution architect — able to design solutions independently, not just execute configuration tasks handed down by others.

 - Experience partnering with or managing systems integrators/implementation partners on complex delivery efforts.

 - Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills; comfortable being the primary escalation point for Manufacturing and Quality process questions.

 - Working understanding of integration concepts and experience partnering on ERP-to-MES/QMS/PLM system integrations.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience producing functional design documents, process documentation, and executive-level updates.

Preferred Qualifications:

 - Prior consulting background (Big 4, Oracle partner, or boutique Oracle Fusion implementation firm) strongly preferred.

 - Direct experience owning or integrating PLM (Teamcenter) with Oracle Fusion Manufacturing/Engineering data.

 - Experience in aerospace, defense, or other regulated/complex discrete manufacturing environments.

 - Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or similar middleware/integration platforms.

 - Oracle Fusion certifications in Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, or Quality.

 - Experience operating in environments with export control, ITAR/CUI, or other regulated data-handling requirements.

AI & Agentic Automation Capabilities:

 - Shield AI is investing in Agentic AI to accelerate and automate manufacturing and quality operations. This role is expected to actively identify, design, and help implement AI-driven automation across Manufacturing, MRP, MES, and QMS — not simply consume AI tools built by others.
 
 - Identify high-value candidates for Agentic AI automation within Manufacturing and Quality — e.g., planner workbench exception triage, shop-floor anomaly detection, quality non-conformance routing/CAPA drafting, and work order scheduling recommendations.
 
 - Design and configure AI agent workflows using Oracle’s embedded AI/ML and agentic capabilities (e.g., Oracle Fusion AI agents, OCI Generative AI, Redwood/AI-driven planning recommendations) as they become available across Fusion Manufacturing and Planning.
 
 - Partner with IT/data teams to define prompts, guardrails, data inputs, and approval/exception paths for AI agents acting on manufacturing and quality transactions, ensuring appropriate human-in-the-loop controls.
 
 - Evaluate and pilot third-party or custom Agentic AI tools (e.g., for predictive maintenance, quality defect pattern detection, MES data synthesis, or supply/demand sensing) and assess fit against the target architecture.
 
 - Use AI-assisted tools for day-to-day solution work — requirements analysis, test script generation, configuration documentation, and data mapping — to increase delivery speed and quality.
 
 - Bring or build fluency in prompt engineering and AI workflow design; prior hands-on experience with generative AI or agentic AI platforms (Oracle AI Agent Studio, OCI Generative AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, UiPath/Automation Anywhere agentic features, or similar) is a strong plus.
 
 - Champion responsible AI adoption — data quality, auditability, and change management — when introducing agentic workflows into regulated, ITAR/CUI-sensitive environments.

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

ABOUT SHIELD AI:

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

We’re looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production. 

You will lead prototype build execution and the manufacturing setup of our new Seattle-area facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll build the production team, establish the factory’s operating system and deliver the readiness needed to scale aircraft production safely, reliably and efficiently. 

This role carries accountability across the full journey: turning lessons from development builds into a repeatable production system, then leading that operation against safety, quality, delivery and cost commitments. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management to make that happen. 

What you'll do:

 - Lead prototype builds and new product introduction 
 
 - Own the day-to-day execution of X-BAT prototype and development aircraft builds, including assembly, integration, rework and build support for testing. 
 
 - Partner with Program Management to establish achievable build schedules, resource plans and milestones, making constraints and trade-offs visible early. 
 
 - Work with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering through build-test-learn cycles, ensuring build issues are captured, resolved and reflected in future designs and production processes. 
 
 - Plan and execute pre-series builds to prove tooling, work instructions, material flow, process controls and workforce readiness before production ramp. 
 
 - Maintain configuration discipline and aircraft traceability throughout development builds in partnership with Engineering and Quality. 
 
 Establish the Seattle production operation 
 
 - Lead manufacturing setup and operational readiness for X-Forge 3, working with Facilities and Manufacturing Engineering on factory layout, equipment installation, commissioning and production flow. 
 
 - Recruit, develop and lead the production organization, building capable frontline leadership and a skilled aircraft assembly team. 
 
 - Own production staffing, training and capacity plans, aligning investment and workforce growth with program demand. 
 
 - Drive launch readiness across people, tooling, materials, processes and quality, with clear owners and closure plans for gaps. 
 
 - Lead the transition from prototype operations into Seattle production, ensuring build knowledge and lessons learned transfer with the work. 
 
 Deliver and scale aircraft production 
 
 - Own production execution against safety, quality, delivery and cost targets as X-BAT moves through initial production and into sustained rate. 
 
 - Establish daily operating routines, visual management and escalation processes that surface problems early and drive timely resolution. 
 
 - Improve throughput, labor productivity, first-pass quality and schedule adherence through practical Lean methods and structured problem-solving. 
 
 - Partner with Supply Chain and Planning to align material availability, supplier readiness and outsourced manufacturing with the production plan. 
 
 - Work with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality to eliminate recurring build issues and embed permanent corrective actions. 
 
 - Deploy digital manufacturing tools and appropriate automation to improve execution, traceability and scalability. 
 
 - Give leadership a clear view of production performance, launch readiness, risks and the decisions needed to maintain progress. 

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing or a related technical field. 

 - 10+ years of experience in aerospace or comparable advanced manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading production teams. 

 - Demonstrated experience leading prototype or new product introduction builds and carrying a product into sustained production. 

 - Proven ability to build and scale manufacturing operations, including workforce development, capacity planning and production systems. 

 - Experience leading complex assembly and integration operations with demanding quality, configuration and traceability requirements. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing readiness, tooling validation, material coordination and production launch. 

 - Track record of improving safety, quality, delivery and cost through Lean manufacturing and structured problem-solving. 

 - Ability to lead across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management, resolving competing priorities and driving clear accountability. 

 - A hands-on leadership style, with the ability to move between long-term factory planning and detailed problem-solving on the floor. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through initial and rate production. 

 - Experience establishing a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites. 

 - Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration and production test. 

 - Familiarity with aerospace quality systems, including AS9100, and digital manufacturing and traceability tools. 

 - Experience managing production interfaces with outsourced manufacturing partners and complex supplier networks. 

 - Advanced degree or relevant training in manufacturing leadership, program management or production launch.

card.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 

Job Description:

As the Staff Advance Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll take ownership of critical manufacturing processes across multiple programs, leading initiatives to increase throughput, reduce costs, and scale our operations. You’ll be instrumental in building out the infrastructure for a new production line supporting a next-generation jet, including selecting and deploying capital equipment, implementing hardware and software tools, and establishing robust production systems. Working across engineering, supply chain, and production, you’ll ensure smooth integration of new technologies and provide mentorship to other engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional impact, technical leadership, and factory-scale execution.

 
 

What you'll do:

 - Define the Bill of Process and manufacturing sequence for assigned subassemblies or cells. 

 - Map MBOM to operations, tooling needs, and process controls. 

 - Build ergonomic workstations (height/reach zones, shadow boards, calibrated torque tools, ESD controls, POU materials). 

 - Create visual, operator-ready Work Instructions with torque specs, PPE, inspection points, and MES revision control. 

 - Conduct time studies, compute takt/CT, identify bottlenecks, and lead kaizen improvements. 

 - Establish standardized work, visual controls, job aids, and layered audit systems; iterate with operators. 

 - Capture shop-floor lessons learned defects, build issues, tooling feedback and drive root cause and corrective action. 

 - Partner with Quality on in-process checks, error-proofing, and FAI readiness. 

 - Implement ECOs, validate process updates, and maintain work instructions accordingly. 

 - Tools & Skills: MES/QMS systems, torque analyzers, Minitab/Excel (SPC, capability, DOE), lean/5S, PFMEA, ergonomic assessment tools, Control Plans, Standard Operating Procedures. 

Required qualifications:

 - 7+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production systems, process development, or assembly engineering. 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Mechatronics, or related STEM field. 

 - Experience in prototype manufacturing in a startup or rapid-growth environment. 

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including machining, composites, avionics and/or assembly. 

 - Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and adapt to changing priorities. 

Preferred qualifications:

 - Knowledge of quality standards, such as AS9100 or ISO 9001. 

 - Proficiency in CAD software 

 - Familiarity with advanced manufacturing technologies, such as additive manufacturing or automation systems. 

 - Hands-on experience with manufacturing equipment and tooling design. 

 - Strong project management skills, including experience managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. card.title: Sr. Director Quality & Regulatory Compliance
card.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

**SCOPE OF ROLE:**

The Senior Director of Quality and Regulatory Compliance is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive quality strategy supporting both the Optics and Fluidics business segments across multiple sites. This leader will drive a high-performing quality organization that delivers best-in-class product quality, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

This role provides oversight of the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Document Control, and Inspection functions. The Senior Director will champion a culture of continuous improvement, proactive risk management, and customer-centric quality while aligning quality strategies with broader business goals.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------

### **Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for the global Idex Health & Science Quality organization, including talent development, performance management, and organizational design (6 international locations)
* Serve as the designated Management Representative, ensuring the effectiveness of the QMS and alignment with business objectives
* Establish and communicate a clear quality vision and strategy across Optics and Fluidics operations

### **Quality Systems & Governance**

* Oversee and continuously improve the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Ensure quality objectives are defined, tracked, and communicated to leadership with clear visibility into performance and risk
* Lead internal and external audit readiness and execution, ensuring timely and effective resolution of findings

### **Performance Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

* Define, implement, and monitor key quality metrics and KPIs to measure internal performance and customer outcomes
* Present quality performance insights to executive leadership and external stakeholders
* Drive a culture of Root Cause Problem Solving (RCPS) and Continuous Improvement (CI) across all functions and product lifecycles
* Lead Cost of Quality (COQ) initiatives to improve operational and financial performance

### **Operational Quality & Engineering Support**

* Partner with Operations and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure quality is embedded across production processes
* Provide leadership for Quality Engineering support, addressing non-conformances through the NCMR system and driving escalation when appropriate
* Lead and oversee Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes, ensuring sustainable solutions to systemic issues
* Support Design for Manufacturability, Testability, and Reliability in new product introductions, transfers, and sustaining initiatives

### **Supplier & Customer Quality**

* Oversee supplier qualification and audit programs, ensuring supplier performance meets quality expectations
* Partner with Incoming Quality Assurance (IQA) to resolve non-conforming materials and drive supplier corrective actions
* Support customer-facing quality activities, including RMAs, complaint investigations, and corrective action programs
* Drive a customer-centric quality approach aligned with performance expectations

### **Inspection, MRB, and Compliance**

* Oversee Inspection and Document Control functions to ensure product and process compliance
* Lead the Material Review Board (MRB) process, managing non-conforming materials including incoming, WIP, and finished goods
* Ensure timely disposition, containment, and systemic resolution of quality issues

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Regulatory teams to drive quality across the value stream
* Lead and participate in cross-functional initiatives and special projects as assigned
* Act as a change agent to challenge the status quo and drive cultural transformation toward proactive quality

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline strongly preferred; advanced degree a plus
* Minimum 15+ years of progressive quality leadership experience
* At least 5 years leading quality across multiple manufacturing sites (or equivalent complexity) required
* Demonstrated success in regulated manufacturing environments

**Technical Expertise**
-----------------------

* Deep knowledge of Quality Management Systems and regulatory standards (ISO 9001, ISO 13485)
* Strong background in quality assurance within manufacturing/operations environments
* Experience with internal auditing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Proficiency in Six Sigma, Lean, and/or Total Quality Management (preferred)
* Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and talent development capabilities
* Strong ability to influence at all organizational levels and build cross-functional partnerships

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

**Total Rewards**

The compensation range for this position is $158,600.00 - $237,800.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

**Benefits Package**

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our-benefits-and-rewards/

**IDEX is an Equal Opportunity Employer**. IDEX gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other consideration or protected category made unlawful by federal, state or local laws.

Likewise, if you are limited in the ability to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, we will determine an alternate way for you to apply. Please contact our Talent Acquisition Team at lfcareers@idexcorp.com for assistance with an accommodation. These contact tools may be used only by individuals with a disability for accommodation requests. Do not inquire as to the status of an application.

card.title: Senior Manager, Quality – Development Programs (R5315)
card.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai https://shield.ai/. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/shield-ai, X https://x.com/shieldaitech, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/shield_ai, and YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@Shield_AI. 

 


JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.

The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

This position requires balancing speed of development with disciplined engineering rigor to support aggressive program schedules while ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.

What you'll do:

 - Development Quality Leadership

 - Serve as the quality leader for XBAT development.

 - Establish quality strategy, objectives, and metrics aligned with program milestones.

 - Integrate quality requirements into the product development lifecycle.

 - Ensure quality considerations are incorporated during system architecture, design reviews, verification, validation, and qualification activities.

 - Partner with Engineering leadership to identify and mitigate technical and programmatic risks.

 - Drive a culture of proactive quality and continuous improvement throughout the program.

Design & Configuration Quality

 - Ensure quality requirements are appropriately captured in product definitions, specifications, and design documentation.

 - Participate in design reviews, change control boards, and configuration management activities.

 - Ensure full configuration and traceability for all material installed into prototype aircraft.

 - Evaluate engineering changes for quality and production readiness impacts.

 - Support requirements verification and validation planning.

 - Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-quality, and design-for-reliability initiatives.

Risk Management & Reliability

 - Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.

 - Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.

 - Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.

 - Support reliability growth planning and execution.

 - Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.

Verification, Validation & Test Quality

 - Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.

 - Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.

 - Support qualification and certification efforts.

 - Establish processes for managing test escapes, failures, and corrective actions.

Nonconformance & Corrective Action Management

 - Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.

 - Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.

 - Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.

 - Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.

 - Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.

Production Readiness & Industrialization

 - Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.

 - Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.

 - Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.

 - Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.

 - Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.

Quality Management System

 - Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.

 - Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.

 - Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.

 - Support internal and external audits as required.

 - Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.

Leadership & Team Development

 - Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.

 - Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.

 - Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.

 - Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.

 - Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.

 - 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.

 - 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.

 - Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.

 - Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.

 - Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.

 - Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.

 - Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.

 - Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.

 - Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.

 - Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.

 - ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.

 - Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

#LI-JM1

#LE

 

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

 

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

 

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Senior Lead Operational Analyst to contribute to the modeling, simulation, and analysis of Shield AI’s aircraft systems. In this role, you will perform analysis at the component, system, mission and campaign levels to evaluate the effectiveness, survivability, and operational impact of our aircraft across multiple domains, missions and applications. You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and defense stakeholders to assess system performance, inform design trade-offs, and improve mission outcomes. 


This position requires a strong working knowledge of military operations, modeling & simulation (M&S), data science, and operational analysis techniques. Your analyses will directly support product decisions and customer engagements by helping demonstrate how Shield AI’s AI-powered platforms perform in realistic and contested operational environments. 

What you'll do:

 - Plan, own and execute operational analyses to assess the effectiveness of autonomous systems in representative military scenarios.

 - Develop and run modeling, simulation, and wargaming analyses to evaluate system performance, mission impact, and survivability in contested environments.

 - Collaborate with engineering teams and product managers to translate operational findings into actionable system insights.

 - Perform trade studies and sensitivity analyses to assess system performance across varying operational conditions, assumptions, and threat environments.

 - Build, modify, and analyze mission-level models using tools such as AFSIM, STK, MATLAB, Python, or similar M&S frameworks.

 - Analyze force-on-force engagements, sensor performance, and autonomy-enabled behaviors to support mission effectiveness assessments.

 - Engage with DoD stakeholders, operators, and analysts to understand mission needs and operational constraints.

 - Contribute to the development and refinement of concepts of operations (CONOPS) for AI-enabled aircraft capabilities.

 - Monitor emerging threats and operational challenges relevant to autonomous and air combat systems.

 - Prepare technical documentation, analysis reports, and briefings for internal teams, customers, and government stakeholders. 

 - Apply modern compute and development best practices (e.g., version control, scripting, scalable compute workflows, and reproducible analysis) to build and maintain reliable analysis pipelines.

 - Be a force multiplier by coaching and developing incoming talent.

Required qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering or math domain.

 - Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of related experience in operational analysis, modeling & simulation, operations research, or related defense or aerospace roles.

 - Active Secret at a minimum.  

 - Ability to obtain a S//SAR level security clearance desired.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Prior experience in force-on-force analysis, CONOPS development, or military campaign modeling.
 
 - Experience with evaluating strategic development and analysis goals for multi-mission/multi-domain applicability.

 - Familiarity with DoD acquisition processes, tools (Brawler, ESAMS, etc.), Joint Capabilities Integration and Development System (JCIDS), and military operational testing.
 
 - Experience leading a product effort from pre-shaping to tactical deployment

 - Prior experience in systems engineering product development lifecycle (SysML or MBSE preferred)
